findings.body: On a fresh Windows laptop, `wsl.exe` can exist while WSL is uninstalled; [Microsoft documents](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/dev-environment/wsl-interop) that it then exits with an error. This call redirects stderr while `$ErrorActionPreference` is `Stop`. In Windows PowerShell 5.1, that combination can terminate the script before `-Check` lists WSL2 as missing or the full run reaches its administrator guidance and `wsl --install` ([PowerShell issue](https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell/issues/4002)). Handle a failed status probe as “WSL2 missing.”
findings.title: Not done: One script sets up a laptop

findings.body: The fresh-WSL test stub prints `WSL is not ready` to stdout and exits successfully. It therefore stays green if a real `wsl --status` failure on stderr stops the installer before either the missing-tools list or administrator guidance. Make this stub fail like an uninstalled WSL and assert the `-Check` and full-run outcomes.
findings.title: Not done: test Windows setup when WSL status fails

findings.body: Any directory with each browser prefix counts as installed, including an incomplete download or revisions left by an older Playwright release; Windows uses the same check at `scripts/install-windows.ps1:21`. Check mode can report nothing missing even though the project's Playwright cannot launch a browser. [Playwright requires browser binaries matched to its version](https://playwright.dev/docs/browsers).
findings.title: Check usable Playwright browsers before skipping installation

findings.body: A standalone `docker` CLI makes this script skip Docker Desktop; Windows uses the same command-only check at `scripts/install-windows.ps1:62`. After a fresh Desktop installation, neither script tells the user to launch it, so setup can finish without a usable Docker engine. Check Desktop separately and print the first-launch action. Docker's [Mac](https://docs.docker.com/desktop/setup/install/mac-install/) and [Windows](https://docs.docker.com/desktop/setup/install/windows-install/) instructions both require starting Desktop.
findings.title: Check Docker Desktop and tell the user to start it
